facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2023-0098 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 30 June 2023 as a scheduled change under change assurance; no event precedes it in the record. The change assurance record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to replace an existing requirement with one written to the current house style. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2016-007, MOC-2026-0413, PRO-MEC-014 and PRO-OPS-032.
